open-datum VERSION (commit unknown)

Usage: open-datum registration COMMAND

Book a registration, take it back, or clean it up

A registration is booked with a key, its payload and a deposit. Until its
processing deadline only a fold spends it; in the window that follows, the
refund address takes everything back; after the window anyone cleans it up,
the deposit returning to the refund address.

Available settings:
  Show this help text
  switch: -h|--help

Available commands:
  book      Book the registration of a key     
  reclaim   Take back a registration you booked
  cleanup   Clean up an expired registration
